title: Swedish fairy tales
author: Herman Hofberg
description: "Swedish Fairy Tales" by Herman Hofberg is a collection of folkloric tales written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: This compilation gathers various traditional stories from Sweden, exploring themes of magic, giants, and whimsical adventures that reflect the deep-rooted culture and mythology of the Swedish people.

authorInfo.bio: Herman Hofberg (1823–1883) wrote Swedish fairy tales. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.

rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.
